findings.desc: Table 3.1 row 'Harmful Manipulation - Uplift CCL', column 'T/CCL Determination': '(carried forward from Argon)' renders upright; the PDF sets it italic, as in every other row of that column (all six other rows render it italic on the web).
findings.evidence: PDF p.16 spans at y=313/326 are GoogleSans-Italic flags=6 '(carried forward from ' / 'Argon) '; sections/03-frontier-safety.md line 53 has 'CCL not reached (carried forward from Argon)' with no , while lines 50-52 and 54-56 wrap it in .

findings.desc: Table 3.2 row 2 ('Specification gaming / mining logs', Monitor-flagged RL), column 'Key finding': the word 'inverse-probability-weighted' renders split as 'inverse-probability-w eighted'. The PDF only wraps the over-long word mid-word at the cell edge (a cell-fit break, no space); the web turned that wrap into a space.
findings.evidence: PDF p.32 lines 'inverse-probability-w' (no trailing space, x 343.5-429.9, right at the column edge) then 'eighted confirmed '; sections/03-frontier-safety.md line 297 has 'inverse-probability-w eighted', while the body prose of the same section spells 'inverse-probability-weighted confirmed'. Card has cell_fit_breaks: true, so this break escaped the knob.
